title: Canonical finite-free coefficient pullback comparison
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], with pulled-back coefficient rings $\Lambda_Z$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and internal module objects and their regular modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. For every morphism of schemes $f:Y\to X$, use the actual ringed-topos module pullback $f^*$ [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback]. For $n\in\mathbf N$, put $\Lambda_Z^n=\bigoplus_{i\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)}\Lambda_Z$. Define the canonical comparison $\kappa_{f,n}:f^*(\Lambda_X^n)\xrightarrow{\sim}\Lambda_Y^n$ as the finite-biproduct comparison of $f^*$ followed on each regular summand by extension/restriction along the canonical coefficient isomorphism and the regular-module comparison induced by that same coefficient map. This is the specified composite, with no choice of basis or arbitrary isomorphism; $n=0$ and all schemes and scheme morphisms are allowed.
